summary: GET /api/runs/{id} on a running run crashes on SQLite: naive vs aware datetime subtraction
description:
Due 2026-11-07. Low priority, after devin's runs. Found during PR #38, confirmed by copilot's review.

`_run_metrics` (backend/anvil/api/app.py, wall time for a run without `ended_at`) computes `utc_now() - run.started_at`. SQLite returns naive datetimes, so a running run raises `TypeError: can't subtract offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes`. Postgres returns aware values, so production is fine, but tests have to drain the event stream first to dodge it.

## Do

* Normalise `started_at`, `ended_at` and `created_at` to UTC-aware in one helper before arithmetic, the way `_run_metrics` already does for usage timestamps.
* Add a test: `GET /api/runs/{id}` while the run is still running returns 200 with a positive `wall_time_seconds`.

## Acceptance

The test passes on SQLite, and the existing tests are unchanged.

comments.body: [devin] Opened PR #41 (https://github.com/vishal7pandey/anvil/pull/41): normalize SQLite-naive and UTC-aware timestamps via _as_utc() in _run_metrics. 19 passed in test_api.py.
